context_title:
Az ÖSSZES hibát megkeresed a kódban Az elsőtől az utolsóig minden karaktert átnézel Csak a konkrét pontos hibákat mindet írod Listába  majd ha megtalaltad az osszes hibat teljes kódot kijavítva vissza küldöd. minden egyes karaktert leírsz, nem rövidítesz. minden hibát kijavítasz. egy fájl marad. ne írj semmi mást csak a teljes kódot es kommentek nem lehetnek benne! soha semmi egyszerusitett mock placeholder dummy szimulalt fake szart nem engedelyezek es teljes fájl roviditetlen production ready kód  egy kód mezőbe írjad a teljes kódot es legyen 100% osan hiba mentes!  es arra törekedj hogy mindenben a kód a lehető legfejlettebb legjobb teljesítményű leggyorsabb és mindenben a legjobb legyen! 

import "lib/github.com/diku-dk/cpprandom/random"

module rng_engine = xorshift128plus

type rng = rng_engine.rng

let CORPUS_SIZE: i64 = 1000i64

let GRID: i64 = 7i64

let KNOTS: [GRID+4]f32 = [-5.0f32, -2.5f32, 0.0f32, 2.5f32, 5.0f32, 7.5f32, 10.0f32, 12.5f32, 15.0f32, 17.5f32, 20.0f32]

let ASTRO_ORBS: [9]f32 = [4.12f32, 4.55f32, 2.63f32, 3.47f32, 8.31f32, 5.08f32, 2.91f32, 6.74f32, 3.11f32]

let QUANTUM_SHOTS: i64 = 1024i64

let TOP_K: i64 = 20i64

let MAX_STEPS: i64 = 10i64

let BATCH_SIZE: i64 = 32i64

let EMBED_DIM: i64 = 128i64

let TEXT_LEN: i64 = 128i64

let META_DIM: i64 = 4i64

let N_GT_DOCS: i64 = 3i64

let N_QUERIES: i64 = 32i64

let N_ROLLOUTS: i64 = 32i64

let N_LAYERS: i64 = 12i64

let VOCAB_SIZE: i64 = 1000i64

let arg_sort_descending (sims: []f32): []i64 =
  let n = length sims
  let indices = iota n
  let pairs = zip (map (\s -> -s) sims) indices
  let sorted = sort_by_key (.0) f32 pairs
  in map (.1) sorted

let num_unique (xs: []i32): i64 =
  let n = length xs
  if n == 0 then 0i64 else
  let sorted = sort xs
  let n1 = n - 1
  let changes = map2 (!=) (sorted[:n1]) (sorted[1:])
  let num_changes = f32.i64 (sum (map i64.bool changes))
  in num_changes + 1i64

let unique (xs: []i32): []i32 =
  let n = length xs
  if n == 0 then [] else
  let sorted = sort xs
  let flags = map (\i -> i == 0 || sorted[i] != sorted[i - 1]) (iota n)
  let positions = filter (\i -> flags[i]) (iota n)
  in map (\p -> sorted[p]) positions

entry init_corpus [n_docs] (seeds: [n_docs]i64): ([n_docs][TEXT_LEN]f32, [n_docs][META_DIM]i32) =
  let texts = loop texts = replicate n_docs (replicate TEXT_LEN 0.0f32) for i < n_docs do
    let rng = rng_engine.mk_rng seeds[i]
    let (toks, _) = loop (toks = replicate TEXT_LEN 0.0f32, rng = rng) for j < TEXT_LEN do
      let (rng', rand_u64) = rng_engine.rand rng
      let rand_tok = f32.u64 (rand_u64 % 1000u64) * ASTRO_ORBS[j % 9i64]
      (toks with [j] = rand_tok, rng')
    texts with [i] = toks
  let metas = loop metas = replicate n_docs (replicate META_DIM 0i32) for i < n_docs do
    let rng = rng_engine.mk_rng (seeds[i] + 12345i64)
    let (mrow, _) = loop (mrow = replicate META_DIM 0i32, rng = rng) for j < META_DIM do
      let (rng', rand_u64) = rng_engine.rand rng
      let mod_val = if j == 0 then 3u64 else if j == 1 then 5u64 else if j == 2 then 100u64 else 2023u64
      let randi = rand_u64 % mod_val
      let val = i32.u64 randi + (if j == 3 then 2000i32 else 0i32)
      (mrow with [j] = val, rng')
    metas with [i] = mrow
  in (texts, metas)

entry kan_spline_basis_iter [n][grid] (x: [n]f32) (knots: [grid+4]f32) (order: i64): [n][grid]f32 =
  loop basis = replicate n (replicate grid 1.0f32) for o < order do
    map (\i ->
      map (\idx ->
        let xi = x[i]
        let left_denom = knots[idx + o] - knots[idx]
        let right_denom = knots[idx + o + 1] - knots[idx + 1]
        let left_num = if left_denom != 0.0f32 then (xi - knots[idx]) / left_denom else 0.0f32
        let right_num = if right_denom != 0.0f32 then (knots[idx + o + 1] - xi) / right_denom else 0.0f32
        let left_val = basis[i][idx]
        let right_val = if idx + 1 < grid then basis[i][idx + 1] else 0.0f32
        (left_num * left_val + right_num * right_val) * ASTRO_ORBS[idx % 9i64]
      ) (iota grid)
    ) (iota n)

entry kan_spline_eval [n][grid] (x: [n]f32) (coeffs: [n][grid]f32) (knots: [grid+4]f32) (order: i64): [n]f32 =
  let basis = if order == 0 then
    map (\xi ->
      map (\i ->
        if i < grid && knots[i] <= xi && xi < knots[i+1] then 1.0f32 else 0.0f32
      ) (iota grid)
    ) x
  else
    kan_spline_basis_iter x knots order
  in map (\i -> f32.sum (map2 (*) basis[i] coeffs[i])) (iota n)

entry semantic_retrieve [n_queries][n_docs][text_len] (queries: [n_queries][text_len]f32) (corpus: [n_docs][text_len]f32) (knots: [GRID+4]f32) (order: i64): [n_queries][TOP_K]i32 =
  let q_embs = map (\q -> kan_spline_eval (replicate EMBED_DIM (f32.sum q / f32.i64 text_len)) (replicate EMBED_DIM (replicate GRID 1.0f32)) knots order) queries
  let c_embs = map (\c -> kan_spline_eval (replicate EMBED_DIM (f32.sum c / f32.i64 text_len)) (replicate EMBED_DIM (replicate GRID 1.0f32)) knots order) corpus
  in map (\q_emb ->
    let sims = map (\c_emb -> f32.sum (map2 (*) q_emb c_emb)) c_embs
    let sorted_indices = arg_sort_descending sims
    let top_ids = map i32.i64 (take TOP_K sorted_indices)
    in top_ids
  ) q_embs

entry keyword_retrieve [n_queries][n_docs][text_len] (queries: [n_queries][text_len]i32) (corpus: [n_docs][text_len]i32): [n_queries][TOP_K]i32 =
  let q_unique = map num_unique queries
  let terms = map i32.i64 (iota VOCAB_SIZE)
  let c_tfs = map (\c ->
    map (\q_term ->
      f32.sum (map (\t -> if t == q_term then 1.0f32 else 0.0f32) c)
    ) terms
  ) corpus
  let scores = map3 (\q c_tf q_len -> 
    let q_tf = map (\t -> f32.sum (map (\qt -> if qt == t then 1.0f32 else 0.0f32) q)) terms
    in f32.sum (map2 (*) c_tf q_tf) / (f32.i64 q_len + 1.0f32)
  ) queries c_tfs q_unique
  in map (\sc ->
    let sorted_indices = arg_sort_descending sc
    in map i32.i64 (take TOP_K sorted_indices)
  ) scores

entry filter_docs [n_cand] (cands: [n_cand]i32) (metas: [n_cand][META_DIM]i32) (constraints: [META_DIM]i32) (seed: i64): [n_cand]i32 =
  let rng = rng_engine.mk_rng seed
  let (_, noises) = loop (rng, noises = replicate QUANTUM_SHOTS 0.0f32) for k < QUANTUM_SHOTS do
    let (rng', rand_u64) = rng_engine.rand rng
    let rng_val = i64.u64 rand_u64 % (1i64 << 31)
    let noise = f32.i64 (rng_val % 1000i64) / 50000.0f32 - 0.01f32
    (rng', noises with [k] = noise)
  let avg_noise = f32.sum noises / f32.i64 QUANTUM_SHOTS
  in map (\i ->
    if all (\j -> metas[i][j] == constraints[j]) (iota META_DIM) then
      if avg_noise > 0.0f32 then cands[i] else -1i32
    else -1i32
  ) (iota n_cand)

entry aggregate_docs [n_docs] (doc_ids: [n_docs]i32) (metas: [n_docs][META_DIM]i32) (t: f32) (op: i32): ([META_DIM]f32, i32) =
  let decay = f32.exp (-t)
  let decayed_metas = map (\m -> map (\v -> f32.i32 v * decay) m) metas
  let synth =
    if op == 0i32 then
      let min_id = reduce i32.min i32.highest doc_ids
      (replicate META_DIM 0.0f32 with [0] = f32.i32 min_id, min_id)
    else if op == 1i32 then
      let cnt = i32.i64 (length doc_ids)
      (replicate META_DIM 0.0f32 with [0] = f32.i32 cnt, cnt)
    else
      let A = replicate META_DIM 0.9f32
      let B = replicate META_DIM 0.1f32
      let C = replicate META_DIM 1.0f32
      let Delta = replicate META_DIM t
      let sum_m0 = f32.sum (map (\m -> m[0]) decayed_metas)
      let sum_ids = f32.sum (map f32.i32 doc_ids)
      let weighted = map4 (\a b c d -> a * sum_m0 + b * d * c * sum_ids) A B C Delta
      (weighted, reduce i32.min i32.highest doc_ids)
  in synth

type tool_call = (i32, [TEXT_LEN]i32, [META_DIM]i32, f32, i32)

entry simulate_trajectory [n_steps][n_docs][n_meta] (query: [TEXT_LEN]i32) (corpus_f: [n_docs][TEXT_LEN]f32) (metas: [n_docs][n_meta]i32) (seeds: [n_steps]i64): ([n_steps][TOP_K]i32, f32) =
  loop (trajs = replicate n_steps (replicate TOP_K 0i32), acc_evidence = 0.0f32) for step < n_steps do
    let tool_id = i32.i64 (step % 4i64)
    let t = f32.i64 step
    let op = i32.i64 (step % 3i64)
    let call = (tool_id, query, replicate n_meta 0i32, t, op)
    let (retrieved, evidence) = 
      if tool_id == 0i32 then
        let q_f = map f32.i32 query
        let ids_f = semantic_retrieve (replicate 1 q_f) corpus_f KNOTS 3i64
        (ids_f[0], f32.sum (map (\id -> if id >= 0i32 then 1.0f32 else 0.0f32) ids_f[0]))
      else if tool_id == 1i32 then
        let corpus_i = map (map i32.f32) corpus_f
        let ids_i = keyword_retrieve (replicate 1 query) corpus_i
        (ids_i[0], f32.sum (map (\id -> if id >= 0i32 then 1.0f32 else 0.0f32) ids_i[0]))
      else if tool_id == 2i32 then
        let ids = filter_docs (map i32.i64 (iota n_docs)) metas (replicate n_meta 0i32) seeds[step]
        let valid_ids = filter (\id -> id >= 0i32) ids
        (take TOP_K valid_ids, f32.i64 (length valid_ids))
      else
        let prev_ids = trajs[step - 1]
        let prev_metas = map (\id -> if id >= 0i32 then metas[i64.i32 id] else replicate n_meta 0i32) prev_ids
        let (synth, min_id) = aggregate_docs prev_ids prev_metas t op
        (replicate TOP_K min_id, f32.sum synth)
    let new_trajs = trajs with [step] = retrieved
    (new_trajs, acc_evidence + evidence / f32.i64 n_steps)

entry collect_trajectories [n_queries][n_docs][text_len][n_meta] (queries: [n_queries][text_len]i32) (corpus: [n_docs][text_len]f32) (metas: [n_docs][n_meta]i32) (expert_seeds: [n_queries * MAX_STEPS]i64): [n_queries]([MAX_STEPS][TOP_K]i32, f32) =
  map (\i ->
    let seed_start = i * MAX_STEPS
    let seeds_slice = expert_seeds[seed_start:seed_start + MAX_STEPS]
    in simulate_trajectory queries[i] corpus metas seeds_slice
  ) (iota n_queries)

entry sft_loss [n_traj][max_steps][top_k] (trajectories: [n_traj]([max_steps][top_k]i32, f32)) (expert_trajectories: [n_traj]([max_steps][top_k]i32, f32)): f32 =
  let traj_flat = flatten (map (\t -> flatten t.0) trajectories)
  let exp_flat = flatten (map (\t -> flatten t.0) expert_trajectories)
  let min_len = min (length traj_flat) (length exp_flat)
  let diffs = map2 (\p e -> if p != e then 1.0f32 else 0.0f32) traj_flat[:min_len] exp_flat[:min_len]
  in f32.sum diffs / f32.i64 min_len

entry rl_reward [n_rollouts][max_steps][top_k][n_gt_docs] (rollouts: [n_rollouts]([max_steps][top_k]i32, f32)) (gt_docs: [n_gt_docs]i32) (gt_answer: i32): [n_rollouts]f32 =
  map (\r ->
    let traj = r.0
    let final_ids = traj[max_steps - 1]
    let pred_ans = reduce i32.min i32.highest final_ids
    let ans_f1 = if pred_ans == gt_answer then 1.0f32 else 0.0f32
    let all_retr = unique (flatten traj)
    let inter = f32.sum (map (\d -> if any (\g -> g == d) gt_docs then 1.0f32 else 0.0f32) all_retr)
    let prec = if length all_retr > 0 then inter / f32.i64 (length all_retr) else 0.0f32
    let rec = inter / f32.i64 n_gt_docs
    let doc_f1 = 2.0f32 * prec * rec / (prec + rec + 1e-8f32)
    let tool_steps = map (\s -> i32.i64 (s % 4i64)) (iota max_steps)
    let n_tools = i32.i64 (num_unique tool_steps)
    let tool_r = if n_tools >= 3i32 then 1.0f32 else 0.0f32
    in ans_f1 + doc_f1 + tool_r
  ) rollouts

entry rloo_update [n_rollouts][grid] (policy_params: [grid]f32) (rewards: [n_rollouts]f32) (rollout_seeds: [n_rollouts]i64): [grid]f32 =
  let baseline = f32.sum rewards / f32.i64 n_rollouts
  let advantages = map (\r -> r - baseline) rewards
  let grad_scale = map (\adv -> adv * 1e-4f32) advantages
  let seed_mod = map (\s -> f32.i64 (s % 1000i64) / 1000.0f32) rollout_seeds
  let grads = map2 (*) grad_scale seed_mod
  let avg_grad = f32.sum grads / f32.i64 n_rollouts
  in map (\p -> p - avg_grad) policy_params

entry marag_r1_train_infer [n_queries][n_docs][text_len][n_meta][n_gt_docs][n_rollouts] (queries: [n_queries][text_len]i32) (corpus: [n_docs][text_len]f32) (metas: [n_docs][n_meta]i32) (gt_docs: [n_queries][n_gt_docs]i32) (gt_answers: [n_queries]i32) (init_seeds: [n_queries * MAX_STEPS + n_rollouts]i64): ([n_queries][TOP_K]i32, f32) =
  let traj_offset = 0i64
  let expert_seeds = init_seeds[traj_offset : traj_offset + n_queries * MAX_STEPS]
  let expert_trajs = collect_trajectories queries corpus metas expert_seeds
  let sft_params = replicate GRID 1.0f32
  let sft_loss_val = sft_loss expert_trajs expert_trajs
  let rl_offset = n_queries * MAX_STEPS
  let rl_seeds = init_seeds[rl_offset : rl_offset + n_rollouts]
  let q_indices = map (\s -> i32.i64 (s % n_queries)) rl_seeds
  let rollouts = map2 (\seed q_idx ->
    let q = queries[i64.i32 q_idx]
    let step_seeds = replicate MAX_STEPS seed
    in simulate_trajectory q corpus metas step_seeds
  ) rl_seeds q_indices
  let rl_rews = rl_reward rollouts gt_docs[0] gt_answers[0]
  let updated_params = rloo_update sft_params rl_rews rl_seeds
  let inf_seeds = init_seeds[0 : n_queries * MAX_STEPS]
  let inf_trajs = collect_trajectories queries corpus metas inf_seeds
  let inf_final = map (\t -> t.0[MAX_STEPS - 1]) inf_trajs
  let avg_reward = f32.sum (map (.1) inf_trajs) / f32.i64 n_queries
  in (inf_final, avg_reward)

entry benchmark_marag (query_seeds: [N_QUERIES]i64): f32 =
  let corpus_seeds = map (\q -> q + 1000i64) query_seeds
  let (texts, metas) = init_corpus corpus_seeds
  let queries_i = map (\seed -> replicate TEXT_LEN (i32.i64 (seed % 1000i64))) query_seeds
  let gt_docs_per_q = replicate N_QUERIES (map i32.i64 (iota N_GT_DOCS))
  let gt_ans = replicate N_QUERIES 0i32
  let all_seeds_len = N_QUERIES * MAX_STEPS + N_ROLLOUTS
  let all_seeds = concat query_seeds (concat corpus_seeds (replicate all_seeds_len 42i64))
  let (_, reward) = marag_r1_train_infer queries_i texts metas gt_docs_per_q gt_ans all_seeds
  in reward

entry keyword_retrieve [n_queries][n_docs][text_len] (queries: [n_queries][text_len]i32) (corpus: [n_docs][text_len]i32): [n_queries][TOP_K]i32 =
  let q_unique = map num_unique queries
  let terms = map i32.i64 (iota VOCAB_SIZE)
  let c_tfs = map (\c ->

    let q_tf = map (\t -> f32.sum (map (\qt -> if qt == t then 1.0f32 else 0.0f32) q)) terms

  let traj_flat = flatten (map (\t -> flatten t.0) trajectories)
  let exp_flat = flatten (map (\t -> flatten t.0) expert_trajectories)
  let min_len = min (length traj_flat) (length exp_flat)
  let diffs = map2 (\p e -> if p != e then 1.0f32 else 0.0f32) traj_flat[:min_len] exp_flat[:min_len]
  in f32.sum diffs / f32.i64 min_len

entry rl_reward [n_rollouts][max_steps][top_k][n_gt_docs] (rollouts: [n_rollouts]([max_steps][top_k]i32, f32)) (gt_docs: [n_gt_docs]i32) (gt_answer: i32): [n_rollouts]f32 =
  map (\r ->
    let traj = r.0
    let final_ids = traj[max_steps - 1]
    let pred_ans = reduce i32.min i32.highest final_ids
    let ans_f1 = if pred_ans == gt_answer then 1.0f32 else 0.0f32
    let all_retr = unique (flatten traj)
    let inter = f32.sum (map (\d -> if any (\g -> g == d) gt_docs then 1.0f32 else 0.0f32) all_retr)
    let prec = if length all_retr > 0 then inter / f32.i64 (length all_retr) else 0.0f32
    let rec = inter / f32.i64 n_gt_docs
    let doc_f1 = 2.0f32 * prec * rec / (prec + rec + 1e-8f32)
    let tool_steps = map (\s -> i32.i64 (s % 4i64)) (iota max_steps)
    let n_tools = i32.i64 (num_unique tool_steps)
    let tool_r = if n_tools >= 3i32 then 1.0f32 else 0.0f32
    in ans_f1 + doc_f1 + tool_r
  ) rollouts

entry rloo_update [n_rollouts][grid] (policy_params: [grid]f32) (rewards: [n_rollouts]f32) (rollout_seeds: [n_rollouts]i64): [grid]f32 =
  let baseline = f32.sum rewards / f32.i64 n_rollouts
  let advantages = map (\r -> r - baseline) rewards
  let grad_scale = map (\adv -> adv * 1e-4f32) advantages
  let seed_mod = map (\s -> f32.i64 (s % 1000i64) / 1000.0f32) rollout_seeds
  let grads = map2 (*) grad_scale seed_mod
  let avg_grad = f32.sum grads / f32.i64 n_rollouts
  in map (\p -> p - avg_grad) policy_params

    in simulate_trajectory queries[i] corpus metas seeds_slice
  ) (iota n_queries)

entry sft_loss [n_traj][max_steps][top_k] (trajectories: [n_traj]([max_steps][top_k]i32, f32)) (expert_trajectories: [n_traj]([max_steps][top_k]i32, f32)): f32 =
  let traj_flat = flatten (map (\t -> flatten t.0) trajectories)
  let exp_flat = flatten (map (\t -> flatten t.0) expert_trajectories)
  let min_len = i64.min (length traj_flat) (length exp_flat)
  let diffs = map2 (\p e -> if p != e then 1.0f32 else 0.0f32) traj_flat[:min_len] exp_flat[:min_len]
  in f32.sum diffs / f32.i64 min_len

entry rl_reward [n_rollouts][max_steps][top_k][n_gt_docs] (rollouts: [n_rollouts]([max_steps][top_k]i32, f32)) (gt_docs: [n_gt_docs]i32) (gt_answer: i32): [n_rollouts]f32 =
  map (\r ->
    let traj = r.0
    let final_ids = traj[max_steps - 1i64]
    let pred_ans = reduce i32.min i32.highest final_ids
    let ans_f1 = if pred_ans == gt_answer then 1.0f32 else 0.0f32
    let all_retr = unique (flatten traj)
    let inter = f32.sum (map (\d -> if any (\g -> g == d) gt_docs then 1.0f32 else 0.0f32) all_retr)
    let prec = if length all_retr > 0i64 then inter / f32.i64 (length all_retr) else 0.0f32
    let rec = inter / f32.i64 n_gt_docs
    let doc_f1 = 2.0f32 * prec * rec / (prec + rec + 1e-8f32)
    let tool_steps = map (\s -> i32.i64 (s % 4i64)) (iota max_steps)
    let n_tools = i32.i64 (num_unique tool_steps)
    let tool_r = if n_tools >= 3i32 then 1.0f32 else 0.0f32
    in ans_f1 + doc_f1 + tool_r
  ) rollouts

entry rloo_update [n_rollouts][grid] (policy_params: [grid]f32) (rewards: [n_rollouts]f32) (rollout_seeds: [n_rollouts]i64): [grid]f32 =
  let baseline = f32.sum rewards / f32.i64 n_rollouts
  let advantages = map (\r -> r - baseline) rewards
  let grad_scale = map (\adv -> adv * 1e-4f32) advantages
  let seed_mod = map (\s -> f32.i64 (s % 1000i64) / 1000.0f32) rollout_seeds
  let grads = map2 (*) grad_scale seed_mod
  let avg_grad = f32.sum grads / f32.i64 n_rollouts
  in map (\p -> p - avg_grad) policy_params

entry marag_r1_train_infer [n_queries][n_docs][text_len][n_meta][n_gt_docs][n_rollouts] (queries: [n_queries][text_len]i32) (corpus: [n_docs][text_len]f32) (metas: [n_docs][n_meta]i32) (gt_docs: [n_queries][n_gt_docs]i32) (gt_answers: [n_queries]i32) (init_seeds: [n_queries * MAX_STEPS + n_rollouts]i64): ([n_queries][TOP_K]i32, f32) =
  let traj_offset = 0i64
  let expert_seeds = init_seeds[traj_offset : traj_offset + n_queries * MAX_STEPS]
  let expert_trajs = collect_trajectories queries corpus metas expert_seeds
  let sft_params = replicate GRID 1.0f32
  let sft_loss_val = sft_loss expert_trajs expert_trajs
  let rl_offset = n_queries * MAX_STEPS
  let rl_seeds = init_seeds[rl_offset : rl_offset + n_rollouts]
  let q_indices = map (\s -> i32.i64 (s % n_queries)) rl_seeds
  let rollouts =
    map2 (\seed q_idx ->
      let q = queries[i64.i32 q_idx]
      let step_seeds = replicate MAX_STEPS seed
      in simulate_trajectory q corpus metas step_seeds
    ) rl_seeds q_indices
  let rl_rews = rl_reward rollouts gt_docs[0i64] gt_answers[0i64]
  let updated_params = rloo_update sft_params rl_rews rl_seeds
  let inf_seeds = init_seeds[0i64 : n_queries * MAX_STEPS]
  let inf_trajs = collect_trajectories queries corpus metas inf_seeds
  let inf_final = map (\t -> t.0[MAX_STEPS - 1i64]) inf_trajs
  let avg_reward = f32.sum (map (\t -> t.1) inf_trajs) / f32.i64 n_queries
  in (inf_final, avg_reward)

entry benchmark_marag (query_seeds: [N_QUERIES]i64): f32 =
  let corpus_seeds = map (\q -> q + 1000i64) query_seeds
  let (texts, metas) = init_corpus corpus_seeds
  let queries_i = map (\seed -> replicate TEXT_LEN (i32.i64 (seed % 1000i64))) query_seeds
  let gt_docs_per_q = replicate N_QUERIES (map i32.i64 (iota N_GT_DOCS))
  let gt_ans = replicate N_QUERIES 0i32
  let all_seeds_len = N_QUERIES * MAX_STEPS + N_ROLLOUTS
  let all_seeds = query_seeds ++ corpus_seeds ++ replicate all_seeds_len 42i64
  let (_, reward) = marag_r1_train_infer queries_i texts metas gt_docs_per_q gt_ans all_seeds
  in reward
